schemes.shortDescription: Monthly financial assistance to destitute persons, disabled, widows, and orphans in Maharashtra.
schemes.fullDescription: The Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana is a premier social assistance scheme implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Special Assistance, Government of Maharashtra. It provides monthly direct financial relief to destitute individuals, persons with blindness or severe physical disabilities, widows, abandoned women, and children with life-limiting illnesses.
schemes.administeringDepartment: Department of Social Justice and Special Assistance, Maharashtra
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Destitute persons, persons with severe disabilities, widows, orphans, and abandoned women
schemes.eligibilityCriteria: Age below 65 years. Family annual income not exceeding ₹21,000 per annum. Minimum 15 years continuous domicile in the State of Maharashtra. Disability degree of 40% or more for divyang applicants.
schemes.benefits: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,500 per month deposited directly into the beneficiary bank account via DBT.
schemes.requiredDocuments: Age Certificate, Tehsildar Income Certificate (family income ≤ ₹21,000), 15-Year Maharashtra Domicile Certificate, Civil Surgeon Disability Certificate (min 40%), Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.
schemes.applicationProcess: Submit completed application form to the local Tehsildar office, Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch, or online via Aaple Sarkar portal (aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in).
schemes.sourceAgency: Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Maharashtra

schemes.shortDescription: State monthly old age pension for impoverished senior citizens aged 65 and above in Maharashtra.
schemes.fullDescription: Shravanbal Seva Rajya Nivruttivetan Yojana is a dedicated old-age social security pension provided by the Government of Maharashtra. Under Category A, destitute senior citizens on the state rural/urban BPL list receive monthly support, while Category B assists senior citizens whose family income is up to ₹21,000 per annum.
schemes.administeringDepartment: Department of Social Justice and Special Assistance, Maharashtra
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 65 years and above residing in Maharashtra
schemes.eligibilityCriteria: Age 65 years and above. Continuous residence of at least 15 years in Maharashtra. Family annual income up to ₹21,000 or registered in the official State BPL roster.
schemes.benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 per beneficiary disbursed through Aadhaar-enabled public financial management system.
schemes.requiredDocuments: Age proof (Birth certificate/School leaving certificate/Voter ID), Domicile certificate (15 years), BPL ration card or Tehsildar income certificate, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook copy.
schemes.applicationProcess: Apply at the local Tehsil Office Sanjay Gandhi Cell or submit online through Aaple Sarkar citizen services.
schemes.sourceAgency: Government of Maharashtra Social Justice Department

schemes.schemeName: Dr. Punjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna
schemes.shortDescription: Hostel maintenance allowance for children of registered marginal farmers and construction workers in higher education.
schemes.fullDescription: Administered by the Directorate of Higher Education, Maharashtra, this scheme provides living allowance to students admitted in higher and professional educational institutions who reside in recognized hostels or rental accommodations outside their native talukas.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Higher education students whose parents are registered alpabhudharak (marginal farmers) or construction workers
schemes.eligibilityCriteria: Admission secured through Centralized Admission Process (CAP). Annual parental income up to ₹8,00,000. Beneficiary must be a resident of a recognized hostel or rented private accommodation.
schemes.benefits: Hostel allowance of ₹30,000 per academic year for Mumbai/Pune/Nagpur/Aurangabad cities, and ₹20,000 per year for other municipal districts.
schemes.requiredDocuments: CAP Allotment Letter, Hostel Warden or Landlord Agreement Certificate, Alpabhudharak Certificate or Registered Construction Worker Board Certificate, Family Income Certificate, Domicile Certificate.
schemes.applicationProcess: Apply online through the MahaDBT Post Matric Scholarship portal at mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in.
schemes.sourceAgency: Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Maharashtra

schemes.schemeName: Savitribai Phule Scholarship for VJNT and SBC Girls
schemes.shortDescription: State stipend for girl students belonging to VJNT and SBC communities enrolled in 5th to 10th standard.
schemes.fullDescription: To curb dropout rates among backward class female students and promote girl-child secondary education, the Government of Maharashtra offers the Savitribai Phule Scholarship for girls studying in government-recognized schools.
schemes.administeringDepartment: Other Backward Bahujan Welfare Department, Maharashtra
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Girl students from VJNT and SBC communities studying in Classes 5 to 10
schemes.eligibilityCriteria: Must be a female student from VJNT (Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes) or SBC (Special Backward Category). Studying in Class 5th to 10th in a recognized state school. No minimum income ceiling for school level.
schemes.benefits: Stipend of ₹100 per month for 10 academic months (Total ₹1,000 per year) transferred to student bank account.
schemes.requiredDocuments: Caste Certificate issued by Competent Authority, School Bonafide Certificate, Student Bank Passbook with IFSC, Aadhaar Card.
schemes.applicationProcess: Institutions upload student rosters directly through the MahaDBT portal or submit institutional lists to the District Social Welfare Officer.
schemes.sourceAgency: Other Backward Bahujan Welfare Department, Government of Maharashtra

schemes.schemeName: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Shetkari Karjamukti Yojna
schemes.shortDescription: Comprehensive institutional crop loan waiver scheme for distressed cultivators in Maharashtra.
schemes.fullDescription: Initiated by the Department of Co-operation and Marketing, Maharashtra, this debt alleviation program clears overdue crop loans of small and marginal farmers directly through banking channels.
schemes.administeringDepartment: Department of Co-operation, Marketing and Textiles, Maharashtra
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Cultivators in Maharashtra who availed short-term crop loans and restructuring
schemes.eligibilityCriteria: Farmers with overdue short-term crop loans up to ₹2,00,000 sanctioned between 1 April 2015 and 31 March 2019 by nationalized, private, or district central cooperative banks.
schemes.benefits: Direct loan waiver relief up to ₹2,00,000 per farmer family credited directly into the loan account.
schemes.requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card with biometric Aadhaar consent, Bank Loan Passbook, 7/12 Land Record Extract and 8A Extract.
schemes.applicationProcess: Aadhaar authentication through bank branch or Aaple Sarkar CSC Kendra upon publication of bank loan account master list.
schemes.sourceAgency: Department of Co-operation and Marketing, Government of Maharashtra

schemes.shortDescription: State social security pension for destitute senior citizens of Rajasthan.
schemes.fullDescription: Under the Rajasthan Social Security Pension Rules, the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment provides monthly non-contributory pensions to elderly citizens residing in Rajasthan to guarantee dignified living standards.
schemes.administeringDepartment: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Rajasthan
schemes.eligibilityCriteria: Women aged 55 years and above, Men aged 58 years and above. Combined family annual income not exceeding ₹48,000 per annum. Continuous resident of Rajasthan. No other pension received.
schemes.benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 per month for beneficiaries up to 75 years; ₹1,250 per month for beneficiaries aged 75 years and above.
schemes.requiredDocuments: Jan Aadhaar Card, Age Proof (School certificate/Voter ID), Family Income Declaration, Bank Account linked to Jan Aadhaar.
schemes.applicationProcess: Apply online through Rajasthan SSP Portal (ssp.rajasthan.gov.in), e-Mitra kiosks, or BDO/Sub-Divisional Officer offices.
schemes.sourceAgency: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Rajasthan

schemes.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Ekal Nari Samman Pension Yojana
schemes.shortDescription: Social security pension for widows, divorced, and separated women in Rajasthan.
schemes.fullDescription: The Mukhyamantri Ekal Nari Samman Pension provides direct monthly financial assistance to single, divorced, destitute, or widowed women residing in Rajasthan to prevent economic distress and vulnerability.
schemes.administeringDepartment: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Rajasthan
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Widows, divorced, and separated women of Rajasthan aged 18 years and above
schemes.eligibilityCriteria: Minimum age 18 years. Woman must be widowed, legally divorced, or deserted. Annual family income not exceeding ₹48,000. Domicile of Rajasthan.
schemes.benefits: Monthly pension scaled by age: ₹1,000/month (18 to 74 years); ₹1,500/month (75 years and above) transferred directly via Jan Aadhaar DBT.
schemes.requiredDocuments: Jan Aadhaar Card, Death Certificate of Husband (for widows) or Court Divorce Decree/Panchayat desertion certificate, Income declaration.
schemes.applicationProcess: Register through local e-Mitra kiosk or submit online application on the Social Security Pension portal.
schemes.sourceAgency: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Rajasthan

schemes.shortDescription: Skill training and monthly unemployment stipend for educated unemployed youth of Rajasthan.
schemes.fullDescription: The Rajasthan Skill, Employment and Entrepreneurship Department runs the Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana to support educated graduates seeking employment. Beneficiaries undertake 4 hours of daily skill development internship in government departments.
schemes.administeringDepartment: Department of Skill, Employment and Entrepreneurship, Rajasthan
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Unemployed graduate youth domiciled in Rajasthan
schemes.eligibilityCriteria: Graduate degree from a recognized university. Age between 21 and 30 years (up to 35 years for SC/ST/Divyang/Women). Annual family income less than ₹2,00,000. Maximum 2 unemployed members per family.
schemes.benefits: Monthly allowance of ₹4,000 for male candidates and ₹4,500 for female, transgender, and specially-abled candidates for up to 2 years.
schemes.requiredDocuments: Jan Aadhaar Card, Degree Certificate / Final Year Marksheet, 10th Certificate for age verification, Rajasthan Bonafide Certificate, Income Certificate.
schemes.applicationProcess: Register on the Employment Exchange portal at employment.livelihoods.rajasthan.gov.in using SSO ID.
schemes.sourceAgency: Department of Skill, Employment and Entrepreneurship, Rajasthan

schemes.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana (Chiranjeevi Health Scheme)
schemes.shortDescription: Universal cashless medical insurance coverage for families residing in Rajasthan.
schemes.fullDescription: The flagship universal health insurance scheme of Rajasthan providing comprehensive cashless in-patient treatment at public and empanelled private multi-specialty hospitals.
schemes.administeringDepartment: Medical, Health and Family Welfare Department, Rajasthan
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: All families residing in the State of Rajasthan holding a Jan Aadhaar card
schemes.eligibilityCriteria: Domicile of Rajasthan holding valid Jan Aadhaar. Free category covers NFSA, SECC 2011, small & marginal farmers, contract workers. Other families eligible with subsidized annual premium contribution of ₹850.
schemes.benefits: Cashless hospital treatment coverage up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year covering 1,798 medical packages and specialized organ transplant procedures.
schemes.requiredDocuments: Jan Aadhaar Card, Aadhaar Card, Ration Card (NFSA status verification).
schemes.applicationProcess: Automatic registration for NFSA/SECC families; self-registration for general families on chiranjeevi.rajasthan.gov.in or through e-Mitra.

schemes.schemeName: Indira Gandhi Shahari Rozgar Guarantee Yojana (IRGY-Urban)
schemes.shortDescription: 125 days of guaranteed annual wage employment for urban households in Rajasthan.
schemes.fullDescription: Modeled after the rural employment guarantee act, IRGY-Urban guarantees 125 days of wage employment every financial year to urban households located within Rajasthan municipal limits.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Adult members of families living within urban local bodies in Rajasthan
schemes.eligibilityCriteria: Residents within the territorial limits of Urban Local Bodies (Municipal Corporations, Councils, Boards) in Rajasthan. Age between 18 and 60 years. Family must hold a Jan Aadhaar card with urban address.
schemes.benefits: 125 days of guaranteed manual or skilled wage work per family per year paid at notified Rajasthan state statutory wage rates into bank account.
schemes.requiredDocuments: Jan Aadhaar Card with urban address registration, Job Card issued by Urban Local Body, Bank account details.
schemes.applicationProcess: Apply for Urban Job Card at the local municipal corporation/council office or online at irgyurban.rajasthan.gov.in.
schemes.sourceAgency: Local Self Government Department, Government of Rajasthan
